description: Streamlined 1-step Specctra .dsn and .kicad_pcb autorouting entry point using standard enclave defaults to achieve 100% completion and 0 KiCad DRC errors, with optional Rev-B ECO partial rerouting. Use calligraphy_compile_board when you need promo codes or rush options. Accepts sample_id, pcb_text, or upload_b64; returns JSON job_id and pricing. Example: sample_id='2l_rp2040'.

customer_email.description: Engineering contact email for job receipt and license attribution.

filename.description: CAD filename with extension used to select the parser.

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb or Specctra .dsn CAD text.

preserve_existing_copper.description: Lock existing routed copper for surgical Rev-B ECO partial reroutes.

project_path.description: Local workstation path to CAD file (STDIO) or sample_id.

requested_sku.description: Target routing tier SKU (vibe_micro, basic_2l, route_3d, turnkey_full).

target_nets.description: Optional list of specific net names for Rev-B ECO reroutes.

name: calligraphy_route_pcb
title: Synthesize & Route Multi-Layer PCB
